item.title: Melania Trump’s documentary premieres at the Kennedy Center ahead of global release
item.description: "Melania" will premiere Thursday at the Kennedy Center, where the Trumps are expected to walk the red carpet before the film opens in theaters worldwide Friday. They hosted a similar viewing at the White House last Saturday.

item.title: Cher, Tina Knowles and the late Rob Reiner are among Audie Awards finalists
item.description: Cher's narration of "Cher: Part One" brought her a nomination for best biography/autobiography, the Audio Publishers Association announced Thursday. The other finalists are Knowles for "Matriarch," which she narrated along with daughters Beyoncé and Solange among others; the late Virginia Giuffre's memoir about her harrowing years with Jeffrey Epstein, "Nobody's Girl," narrated by Thérèse Plummer and Gabra Zackman; a recording of the late Maya Angelou's "The Heart of a Woman," narrated by Uzo Ad

item.title: King Charles III’s documentary sets out his philosophy for saving the planet
item.description: "It all boils down to the fact that we are actually nature ourselves, we are a part of it, not apart from it, which is really how things are being presented for so long,'' Charles says in the closing moments of the documentary before turning to Shakespeare. "Maybe, by the time I shuffle off this mortal coil, there might be a little more awareness … of the need to bring things back together again.''

item.title: US life expectancy hit an all-time high in 2024, CDC says
item.description: "It's pretty much good news all the way around," said Robert Anderson, of the National Center for Health Statistics at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which released the 2024 data on Thursday.

item.title: CALDARA: Stalled population growth a sign of Colorado in decline

item.description: Mangione's attempted release occurred during a critical stage of his cases.

item.title: Boys Basketball: Rangeview flies high in victory over rival Vista PEAK Prep
item.description: Five Rangeview players scored in double figures — led by senior Aidan Perez's 25 points — in an 85-51 City League home win over rival Vista PEAK Prep Wednesday night.

item.title: Girls Basketball: Long-awaited Smoky Hill resurgence strengthens loaded Centennial League
item.description: The Smoky Hill girls basketball team has already won more games than it had in the three previous seasons combined — which includes a victory over Cherry Creek after more than two decades — to add further depth to a Centennial League that is already extremely healthy.
